name: DUDU
detailed_description: A casual mini-game where you collect garbage, gather plants and fruits, and collect unknown items and resources, then exchange them for gold coins at different recycling stations. After earning money, you can purchase the character outfits, clothes, hats, etc. you want. You can also buy various beautiful and luxurious houses and place furniture in them. You can also purchase a huge ranch and bring back all the unknown little animals like DUDU after defeating them to your ranch to raise. Let them help you produce the resources you need. There are three major areas in the game world, with all kinds of magical little animals waiting for you to discover. The game has a cute art style, a relaxing gameplay, and is not time-consuming. As long as you spend time, you can obtain.
